sourceVisualNotes: The actually viewed source1713 and1717 both show the same tall center-ridge/long-side-horn gold helmet silhouette despite distinct source catalog labels; preserve this evidence rather than claim a recovered different original. For our own designs,1713 arrow/feather and1717 pouring-water details below are explicit new visual interpretation of the descriptions, not recovered source pixels. Source1444's human/film face is replaced by our own bird crest.

items.name: phoenix-jade-coronet
items.designBrief: A broad frontal golden phoenix ceremonial crown, layered flame-feathers and long thin jewel dangles, jade central bird beak crest instead of source human face. Radiating feathers, distinguish from dragon antlers, no movie identity.

items.name: brave-teal-circlet
items.designBrief: Low open teal-jade warrior browband, central vertical pink-cinnabar oval jewel, sharply rising outer cloud-wing fins and two short cheek tips. No face, no gameplay aura.

items.name: crab-claw-helm
items.designBrief: Gold open-face ceremonial helmet with TWO very tall upright crab-claw side prongs, short stacked horizontal fin ridges, small central red gem and gently rounded forehead. Original cloud engraving, no anime armor copy.

items.name: mountain-horn-helm
items.designBrief: Distinct bronze-warm-gold helmet with broad sweeping goat-like curled horns, a smooth central leaf-shaped raised brow and long rounded cheek guards; jade small rivets. Horns bow outward and inward, clearly not straight crab pincers.

items.name: feather-arrow-helm
items.designBrief: Open gold helmet with high central arrowhead-shaped crest, two very elongated slender swept-up side wings, open U face gap, fine feather lines and one subtle arrow motif on brow. Warm gold, ivory feather tips and jade jewel.

items.name: water-cloud-helm
items.designBrief: Same family tall center-ridge and long upswept side-prong OPEN gold helm, but our new water-bearing interpretation uses flowing jade wave insets, tiny amphora-shaped brow jewel and carved curling water lines. Not an actual liquid aura or copied Aquarius anime helm.
